full_judgment: "47. Limitation in imposing claims—(1) Notwithstanding anything contained in any other law for the time being in force or in any contract concluded between the parties, in the event of instituting a suit under this Act, no financial institution shall institute a suit before the Court imposing the liability on the principal loan given to debtor in such manner that the entire claims submitted in the Court exceeds 200% (100 + 200 –7300 taka) of the principal.
